Video

Enough climate hushing. Democrats need to fight.

Video
That’s a wrap on our 16th annual #EEODayRI! Thank you to all of our esteemed guests and panelists for your dedication to our state and planet.
.@GavinNewsom: "Let’s not give in to fear, cynicism, or anxiety. We are the antidote to that." #EEODayRI

We have three excellent breakout sessions this year at #EEODayRI:

🌊 What’s Happening in RI Waters
🐟 Exploring RI’s Blue Economy
🌀 What We’ve Learned from the Block Island Wind Farm

🐟 Exploring RI’s Blue Economy

Approximately 8% of Rhode Islanders work in the seven industries that comprise Rhode Island’s blue economy. In this panel, we’re discussing how to continue capitalizing on this growth and emerging technologies in the space.

🌊 What’s Happening in RI Waters

In this panel, we’re hearing an update on the health of our local waters, ongoing research and studies, Federal and State assistance, and what rising temperatures mean for the future of Rhode Island and our blue economy.
.@Rep_Magaziner: “In order to be effective stewards, we need partnership. Here in RI, we are doing it the right way”. #EEODayRI

As ranking member of @EPWCmte, I’ve been working to expose the looming climate-driven insurance crisis.

As extreme weather worsens, insurance markets are feeling the strain — and your wallet will take the brunt of it.

Our next #EEODayRI panel breaks it down.
.@GeoffreySupran: "This is basically a very wonky way of what @SenWhitehouse was saying, which is: we need to fight like hell." #EEODayRI

The fossil fuel industry is probably the biggest fraud apparatus in the history of mankind.
 
It should be joyous to take that machine down. #EEODayRI

I’m honored to present this year’s Service Award to former RI State Conservationist, Phou Vongkhamdy. 

Phou gives 110 percent to everything he works on.

Thank you for your leadership and dedication to our environment.

#EEODayRI

Next up, I’m joined by Dr. @GeoffreySupran to dig into climate obstructionism.

For decades, fossil-fuel-funded disinformation has blocked climate progress.

Sunlight is the best disinfectant.

I’m kicking off #EEODayRI with Rhode Island Attorney General Neronha.

In the face of Trump’s anti-wind attacks, leaders like @AGNeronha have done excellent work on the home front to push for clean energy and hold polluters accountable.

Good morning from my 16th annual RI Energy, Environment, and Oceans Leaders Day!

Every year at #EEODayRI, we bring together scientists, environmental leaders, and advocates working to keep our planet and our communities safe and healthy 🌎

I hope you’ll follow along!
Swap Putin for Orban here: “Orbán has been with the president for a very long time. He was with him through the trials and tribulations, through the entire campaign.” politico.eu/article/last-thr…
An aged and compromised Commander-in-Chief is losing his grip on reality, increasing dangers at home and for our brave troops overseas.

Threatening to inflict massive civilian casualties is un-American; the stuff of cruel dictators. 

Republicans should no longer stand idly by.
